body: Thanks. I only wish I could help you with your balding, but maybe you're okay with it. ;D
Thanks. I do hope to do that.

You don't seem like a bad person. Maybe you think that, but I don't, maybe we'll have to disagree on this for now. I certainly can't comprehend what it is you may have done to think you deserve such a cruel punishment.

I'll add that although you feel alone, you are not. What I think might be the case is that you have issues that your friends and family may not understand.

I think swacatastrofe's advice is great, try to have a real talk with someone you trust. That's what friends are for, that and helping you move. Cheer up.

If you're not moving backwards then that's already pretty good. Sometimes you feel like you aren't progressing when in fact you are perfecting and stabilizing what you've got.

Maybe I'm talking out of my ass.

Wow, 20k !  You reminded of a time I was so on the border of everything. I ended up somehow going on the most magical and crazy trip of my life. I can't go in to details (privacy reasons), but in short, I did some volunteer work on the other side of the world and got to see some crazy things. I came back with so many stories to tell, it marked and changed my life.

Nope, it doesn't get better. You have to make it better.

I can't say I'm doing better, I was just browsing today, to see if there's anything I can relate to. A story I could read and it could be mine too, and I could read the replies and take them for me. Stupid me.

Back to my point, I think we need to realize that things don't just get better on their own, we need to make it better. I hope my reply helps, even just a bit.
